newsitem.title: USA: KKR still interested in property insurance deals.
newsitem.headline: KKR still interested in property insurance deals.

text.p: Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co, which called off plans to buy Xerox Corp's Talegen insurance business, is still interested in the property-casualty insurance business, a KKR spokeswoman said.
The collapse of KKR's $2.7 billion deal to buy Talegen spurred speculation on Wall Street that the buyout specialist might be cooling to the insurance industry.
"What I'm really trying to debate is whether KKR is no longer a buyer in the insurance industry," said Lehman analyst Peter Wade.
Wade said increasing competition and deterioration in insurance pricing may be making the industry less attractive to prospective buyers like KKR.
The KKR spokeswoman declined to comment on the reason why the deal was terminated.
